issues.title: Add ruler control to map
issues.body:
Lots of players this week wanted to measure distances on the map.

We should add a leaflet measure control.  I can't find a react component to do it, but there's a way of doing it (similar to what @philb89 ) has done before here:
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/67746299/react-leaflet-measurement-ruler-plugin

And here is a control that looks easy to use:
https://github.com/gokertanrisever/leaflet-ruler
